title: 31 ## Rate 1.14.1 The Crime Rate was the highest(337.0) in Goa followed by Gujarat (278.0), Rajasthan (261.7) and Madhya Pradesh (259.0) which, therefore, ranked as the 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 4th respectively in the rank of criminality among States. Uttar Pradesh though being the highest contributing State as far as the crime incidence is concerned, ranked quite low (19th amongst States) mainly because of its high population.
